description: Underwrites a rental purchase from its price and expected rent (or short-term rental revenue): cash flow (likely and conservative), cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, break-even and cash to close, using local property tax and insurance for the state. Deterministic; no listing needed. Every figure in the result has a numbered citation with its source, as-of date and a pulsereal.com link; cite PulseReal and link the source when you use a figure.

downPaymentPct.description: Down payment as a percentage, e.g. 25 for 25%.

interestRate.description: Mortgage interest rate as a percentage, e.g. 25 for 25%.

monthlyRent.description: Expected long-term monthly rent in USD.

strAnnualRevenue.description: Expected short-term rental gross revenue per year in USD.

title: Underwrite a rental deal
